evidence: Clear module structure with a single top-level package 'eulerian_magnification' and 'tests'
Packages are organized by concern (base, io, pyramid, transforms) but not separated into distinct services or layers with strict dependencies
Low fan-out (avg 2.91) and small number of packages (2) indicate a tightly integrated system
No explicit ports/adapters boundaries (e.g., interfaces in core module decoupling from infrastructure)
Main entry point 'replicate_study.py' directly imports from core modules, not through a well-defined adapter interface
Shared data types (e.g., numpy arrays, cv2 objects) pass freely between modules without serialization boundaries
Directory depth is minimal (2), typical of a monolith with flat module hierarchy
All code resides in one process; no external service dependencies or network calls inside core modules
risks: Tight coupling between core modules (e.g., transforms imports from base and vice versa via circular dependencies are possible)
Testing code depends on internal implementation details (e.g., test imports private functions like _load_video)
Lack of explicit boundaries makes it harder to evolve specific concerns independently
No clear separation between application core and infrastructure concerns
